<div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"><pre>map "https://fhir.labs.smartregister.org/fhir/StructureMap/5667cfbd-13c4-4111-b952-7cee58bdb9d5" = 'eCBIS Family Registration'

uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/QuestionnaireReponse" as source
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle" as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Group" as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Encounter" as target

group eCBISFamilyRegistration(source src : QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src -> bundle.id = uuid() "rule_bundle_id";
    src -> bundle.type = 'collection' "rule_bundle_type";
    src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Group') as group then {
       src -> group.id = uuid() "rule_group_id_generation";
       src then ExtractGroup(src, group), ExtractEncounter(src, bundle, group) "rule_bundle_entries";

    } "rule_extract_bundle";
}

group ExtractGroup(source src : QuestionnaireResponse, target group : Group) {
    src -> group.name = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '64712707-d6eb-4166-8d6e-06fa2b9fcf3e').answer.value) "rule_group_name";

    src -> group.identifier = create('Identifier') as groupIdentifierHouseholdId then {
        src -> groupIdentifierHouseholdId.value = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = 'ce49bde4-6ef9-423e-c747-efab250cd770').answer.value)
        "rule_group_identifier_national_id_value";
        src -> groupIdentifierHouseholdId.use = "official" "rule_group_identifier_national_id_use";
        src -> groupIdentifierHouseholdId.period = create('Period') as period, period.start = evaluate(src, $this.authored) "rule_group_identifier_period";
    } "rule_group_identifier_national_id";

    src -> group.identifier = create('Identifier') as groupIdentifier then {
        src -> groupIdentifier.value = uuid() "rule_group_identifier_value";
        src -> groupIdentifier.use = "secondary" "rule_group_identifier_use";
        src -> groupIdentifier.period = create('Period') as period, period.start = evaluate(src, $this.authored) "rule_group_identifier_period";
    } "rule_group_identifier";

    src -> group.active = true "r_grp_status_data";

    src -> group.characteristic = create('Group_Characteristic') as includeFamily then {
        src -> includeFamily.exclude = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '4c7a479f-9ee5-432c-8b49-2f605d3851e9').answer.value) "rule_exclude_group_false";
    } "rule_group_char";

    // Family Name Characteristic for searching
    src -> group.characteristic = create('Group_Characteristic') as familyCharacteristic then {
        src -> familyCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as familyCharacteristicCode then{
            src -> familyCharacteristicCode.coding = c("https://smartregister.org/", "hh_name") as coding then {
            src -> coding.display = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '64712707-d6eb-4166-8d6e-06fa2b9fcf3e').answer.value) "rule_group_name";
            } "r_grp_vcode";
        } "rule_group_char_code";
    } "rule_group_char";    

    // Longitude Name
    src -> group.characteristic = create('Group_Characteristic') as familyCharacteristic then {
        src -> familyCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as familyCharacteristicCode then{
            src -> familyCharacteristicCode.coding = c("https://smartregister.org/", "longitude") as coding then {
            src -> coding.display = evaluate(src, $this.contained.first().position.longitude) "r_cp_cod_disp_v";
            } "r_grp_vcode";
        } "rule_group_char_code";
    } "rule_group_char";    

    // Latitude Name
    src -> group.characteristic = create('Group_Characteristic') as familyCharacteristic then {
        src -> familyCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as familyCharacteristicCode then{
            src -> familyCharacteristicCode.coding = c("https://smartregister.org/", "latitude") as coding then {
            src -> coding.display = evaluate(src, $this.contained.first().position.latitude) "r_cp_cod_disp_v";
            } "r_grp_vcode";
        } "rule_group_char_code";
    } "rule_group_char";

    // Catchment Name
    src.item as catchmentName where(linkId='4c7a479f-9ee5-432c-8b49-2f605d3851e9') -> group.characteristic = create ('Group_Characteristic') as groupCharacteristic then {
        catchmentName -> groupCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as catchmentCode then{
            src -> catchmentCode.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_catchment") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Catchment' "r_cp_cod_disp_catchment";
            } "r_grp_catchmentcode";
            src -> catchmentCode.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '4c7a479f-9ee5-432c-8b49-2f605d3851e9').answer.value) "r_vcc_hh_catchment";
        } "r_cp_cc_coding_catchment";
        catchmentName -> groupCharacteristic.value = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            catchmentName -> concept.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_catchment") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Catchment' "r_cp_cod_disp_value_catchment";
            } "r_grp_value_code_catchment";
            catchmentName -> concept.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '4c7a479f-9ee5-432c-8b49-2f605d3851e9').answer.value) "rule_value_codeable_concept_text_catchment";
        } "rule_value_codeable_concept_catchment";
        catchmentName -> groupCharacteristic.exclude = false "r_cp_cc_exclude_catchment";
    } "r_group_char_catchment";
            
    // Source of Drinking Water
    src.item as sourceDrinkingWater where(linkId='3a08b4c0-619f-4c14-aa39-a4905b5a74cb') -> group.characteristic = create ('Group_Characteristic') as groupCharacteristic then {
            sourceDrinkingWater -> groupCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as dwCode then{
                src -> dwCode.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_drinking_water") as coding then {
                    src -> coding.display = 'Household Drinking Water' "r_cp_cod_disp_dw";
                } "r_grp_dw";
                src -> dwCode.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '3a08b4c0-619f-4c14-aa39-a4905b5a74cb').answer.value.code) "r_vcc_hh_dw";
            } "r_cp_cc_coding_dw";
            sourceDrinkingWater -> groupCharacteristic.value = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            sourceDrinkingWater -> concept.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_drinking_water") as coding then {
                    src -> coding.display = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '3a08b4c0-619f-4c14-aa39-a4905b5a74cb').answer.value.display) "rule_value_codeable_concept_display_dw"; 
                    // 'Household Drinking Water' "r_cp_cod_disp_value_dw";
                } "r_grp_value_code_dw";
                sourceDrinkingWater -> concept.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '3a08b4c0-619f-4c14-aa39-a4905b5a74cb').answer.value.code) "rule_value_codeable_concept_text_dw";
            } "rule_value_codeable_concept_dw";
            sourceDrinkingWater -> groupCharacteristic.exclude = false "r_cp_cc_exclude_dw";
    } "r_group_char_dw";
    
    // Type of toilet
    src.item as typeofToilet where(linkId='f35b9bf9-b878-478c-b66e-d9ef89ba3dd9') -> group.characteristic = create ('Group_Characteristic') as groupCharacteristic then {
        typeofToilet -> groupCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as catchmentCode then{
            src -> catchmentCode.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_toilet") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Toilet Type' "r_cp_cod_disp_tt";
            } "r_grp_ttcode";
            src -> catchmentCode.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = 'f35b9bf9-b878-478c-b66e-d9ef89ba3dd9').answer.value.code) "r_vcc_hh_tt";
        } "r_cp_cc_coding_tt";
        typeofToilet -> groupCharacteristic.value = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            typeofToilet -> concept.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_toilet") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Toilet Type' "r_cp_cod_disp_value_tt";
            } "r_grp_value_code_tt";
        typeofToilet -> concept.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = 'f35b9bf9-b878-478c-b66e-d9ef89ba3dd9').answer.value.code) "rule_value_codeable_concept_text_tt";
        } "rule_value_codeable_concept_tt";
        typeofToilet -> groupCharacteristic.exclude = false "r_cp_cc_exclude_tt";
    } "r_group_char_tt";
    
    // Method of Ventilation
    src.item as methodofVentilation where(linkId='92100091-1f91-4858-8665-0d82aeda2f76') -> group.characteristic = create ('Group_Characteristic') as groupCharacteristic then {
        methodofVentilation -> groupCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as catchmentCode then{
            src -> catchmentCode.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_ventilation") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Ventilation' "r_cp_cod_disp_vent";
            } "r_grp_ventcode";
            src -> catchmentCode.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '92100091-1f91-4858-8665-0d82aeda2f76').answer.value.code) "r_vcc_hh_vent";
        } "r_cp_cc_coding_vent";
        methodofVentilation -> groupCharacteristic.value = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            methodofVentilation -> concept.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_ventilation") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Ventilation' "r_cp_cod_disp_value_vent";
            } "r_grp_value_code_vent";
            methodofVentilation -> concept.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '92100091-1f91-4858-8665-0d82aeda2f76').answer.value.code) "rule_value_codeable_concept_text_vent";
        } "rule_value_codeable_concept_vent";
        methodofVentilation -> groupCharacteristic.exclude = false "r_cp_cc_exclude_vent";
    } "r_group_char_vent";
    
    // Method of Heating
    src.item as methodofHeating where(linkId='07192e94-1783-49f0-b09f-f752be3738af') -> group.characteristic = create ('Group_Characteristic') as groupCharacteristic then {
        methodofHeating -> groupCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as catchmentCode then{
            src -> catchmentCode.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_heating") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Heating' "r_cp_cod_disp_heating";
            } "r_grp_heatingcode";
            src -> catchmentCode.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '07192e94-1783-49f0-b09f-f752be3738af').answer.value.code) "r_vcc_hh_heating";
        } "r_cp_cc_coding_heating";
        methodofHeating -> groupCharacteristic.value = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            methodofHeating -> concept.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_heating") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Heating' "r_cp_cod_disp_value_heating";
            } "r_grp_value_code_heating";
            methodofHeating -> concept.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '07192e94-1783-49f0-b09f-f752be3738af').answer.value.code) "rule_value_codeable_concept_text_heating";
        } "rule_value_codeable_concept_heating";
        methodofHeating -> groupCharacteristic.exclude = false "r_cp_cc_exclude_heating";
    } "r_group_char_heating";
    
    // Handwashing Facility
    src.item as handwashingFacility where(linkId='e9c52de0-a159-4bab-b894-196f58b88a23') -> group.characteristic = create ('Group_Characteristic') as groupCharacteristic then {
        handwashingFacility -> groupCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as catchmentCode then{
            src -> catchmentCode.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_handwashing_facility") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Handwashing' "r_cp_cod_disp_handwashing";
            } "r_grp_handwashingcode";
        src -> catchmentCode.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = 'e9c52de0-a159-4bab-b894-196f58b88a23').answer.value.code) "r_vcc_hh_handwashing";
        } "r_cp_cc_coding_handwashing";
        handwashingFacility -> groupCharacteristic.value = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            handwashingFacility -> concept.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_handwashing_facility") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Handwashing' "r_cp_cod_disp_value_handwashing";
            } "r_grp_value_code_handwashing";
            handwashingFacility -> concept.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = 'e9c52de0-a159-4bab-b894-196f58b88a23').answer.value.code) "rule_value_codeable_concept_text_handwashing";
        } "rule_value_codeable_concept_handwashing";
        handwashingFacility -> groupCharacteristic.exclude = false "r_cp_cc_exclude_handwashing";
    } "r_group_char_handwashing";
    
    // Handwashing Consumable
    src.item as handwashingConsumable where(linkId='31c8d622-6822-45b3-ba4a-a4471fc245fb"') -> group.characteristic = create ('Group_Characteristic') as groupCharacteristic then {
        handwashingConsumable -> groupCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as catchmentCode then{
            src -> catchmentCode.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_handwashing_consumable") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Handwashing Consumable' "r_cp_cod_disp_handwashingcons";
            } "r_grp_handwashingconscode";
            src -> catchmentCode.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '31c8d622-6822-45b3-ba4a-a4471fc245fb"').answer.value.code) "r_vcc_hh_handwashingcons";
        } "r_cp_cc_coding_handwashingcons";
        handwashingConsumable -> groupCharacteristic.value = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            handwashingConsumable -> concept.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_handwashing_consumable") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Handwashing Consumable' "r_cp_cod_disp_value_handwashingcons";
            } "r_grp_value_code_handwashingcons";
            handwashingConsumable -> concept.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '31c8d622-6822-45b3-ba4a-a4471fc245fb"').answer.value.code) "rule_value_codeable_concept_text_handwashingcons";
        } "rule_value_codeable_concept_handwashingcons";
        handwashingConsumable -> groupCharacteristic.exclude = false "r_cp_cc_exclude_handwashingcons";
    } "r_group_char_handwashingcons";
        
    // Village Name
    src -> group.characteristic = create('Group_Characteristic') as familyCharacteristic then {
        src -> familyCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as familyCharacteristicCode then{
            src -> familyCharacteristicCode.coding = c("https://smartregister.org/", "active") as coding then {
            src -> coding.display = 'Active' "r_cp_cod_disp_v";
            } "r_grp_vcode";
        } "rule_group_char_code";
    } "rule_group_char";

    src -> group.type = 'person' "r_grp_type_data";
    src -> group.actual = true "r_grp_actual_data";
    src -> group.code = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then ExtractFamilyCode(src, concept) "r_grp_code_data";

    src.item as familyHome where(linkId='7d9dba4c-7407-4eb2-d791-2d1834b6afcc') -> group.characteristic = create ('Group_Characteristic') as groupCharacteristic then {
        familyHome -> groupCharacteristic.code = create('CodeableConcept') as villageCode then {
            src -> villageCode.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_village") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Village' "r_cp_cod_disp_v";
            } "r_grp_vcode";
            src -> villageCode.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '7d9dba4c-7407-4eb2-d791-2d1834b6afcc').answer.value) "r_vcc_hh_village";
        } "r_cp_cc_coding_v";
        familyHome -> groupCharacteristic.value = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            familyHome -> concept.coding = c("http://ona.io/codes", "hh_village") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Household Village' "r_cp_cod_disp_value";
            } "r_grp_value_code";
            familyHome -> concept.text = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = '7d9dba4c-7407-4eb2-d791-2d1834b6afcc').answer.value) "rule_value_codeable_concept_text";
        } "rule_value_codeable_concept";
        familyHome -> groupCharacteristic.exclude = false "r_cp_cc_exclude_v";
    } "r_group_char_v";
}

group ExtractEncounter(source src : QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle: Bundle, source group : Group) {
    src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Encounter') as encounter then {
        src -> encounter.id = uuid() "r_en_id";
        src -> encounter.status = 'finished' "r_en_st";
        src -> encounter.class = c("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActCode", "HH", "home health") "r_en_cls";
        src -> encounter.type = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            src -> concept.coding = c("http://snomed.info/sct", "184048005") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'Consultation' "r_en_cod_disp";
            } "r_en_cc_cod";
            src -> concept.text = 'Consultation' "r_en_typ_text";
        } "r_en_typ";
        src -> encounter.priority = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            src -> concept.coding = c("http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-ActPriority", "EL") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'elective' "r_en_cod_disp";
            } "r_en_cc_cod";
            src -> concept.text = 'elective' "r_en_prio_text";
        } "r_en_prio";
        src -> encounter.subject = create('Reference') as ref then {
            src -> ref.reference = evaluate(src, 'Group/' + group.id) "rule_related_person_patient_ref";
        } "rule_encounter_subject";
        src -> encounter.period = create('Period') as enPeriod then {
            src -> enPeriod.start = evaluate(src, now()) "r_en_per_start";
            src -> enPeriod.end = evaluate(src, now()) "r_en_per_end";
        } "r_en_per";
        src -> encounter.reasonCode = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            src -> concept.coding = c("http://smartregsiter.org/", "family_registration") as coding then {
                src -> coding.display = 'eCBIS Family Registration' "r_en_rc_cod_disp";
            } "r_en_rc_cod";
            src -> concept.text = 'eCBIS Family Registration' "r_en_text";
        } "r_en_reason";
        // serviceProvider = automatically added in code
    } "r_en";
}

group ExtractFamilyCode(source src : Group, target concept: CodeableConcept) {
    src -> concept.coding = c("https://www.snomed.org", "35359004") as coding then {
        src -> coding.display = 'Family' "r_cp_cod_disp";

    } "r_cp_cc_cod";
}
</pre></div>
